notes: Them CHON NGON NGU cho truyen, ap cho TOAN BO cau chuyen + moi chapter. Tab SmartTraffic: nut tich 'Ap ngon ngu da chon cho moi truyen' + o chon 16 ngon ngu (English, Vietnamese, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Indonesian, Thai, Filipino, Hindi, Arabic, Turkish, Japanese, Korean, Chinese). KHONG tich = mac dinh tieng Anh nhu truoc gio. Khi tich: chen chi thi ngon ngu vao MOI loi goi Writer (story architecture, tung batch chapter, metadata, Facebook caption, tieu de video) nen ten truyen, meta, TEN tung chapter, NOI DUNG tung chapter va caption deu dung ngon ngu da chon; ghi de moi cau lenh 'English/American English' trong prompt goc; giu nguyen ten rieng (ten nhan vat/dia danh). SUA LOI CHAN: truoc day 'language' nam trong FIXED_PRODUCTION_SETTINGS nen apply_fixed_production_settings() GHI DE moi lua chon va luon ep ve English — da bo ghim. Da test: khong tich -> prompt y nguyen nhu cu (khong chen gi); tich -> chi thi dung ngon ngu o ca 5 loai loi goi; GUI bat/tat o chon dung; config khong bi ghi de (MD5 khong doi).
